findings.title: Location pages are 94-97% boilerplate
findings.evidence: 21-42 unique words per page after city normalization; pairwise 6-gram Jaccard 0.76-0.88
findings.fix: Add 250-400 words of local substance per page or consolidate into /locations/ with 301s

findings.title: Site imagery appears AI-generated and is presented as cleaning results
findings.evidence: Recurring identical models, CN Tower in every interior, cleaner in clinical scrubs; gallery alt text says 'cleaning results'
findings.fix: Replace with real crew and site photos; retitle or remove the gallery

findings.title: /reviews/ contains no reviews
findings.evidence: 35 words; form only; meta promises 'real Google reviews'
findings.fix: Embed dated Google reviews and attributed testimonials

findings.title: About page thin and anonymous
findings.evidence: 170 words; no owner, team, photos, or WSIB/insurance evidence
findings.fix: 600-900 words with named people, history, verifiable numbers, credentials

findings.title: Blog stale, undated and unattributed
findings.evidence: 38 posts, newest 2023-03-31; no visible date or byline; JSON-LD author is the Organization; dateModified = datePublished
findings.fix: Visible dates, named Person author, refresh/consolidate per plan

findings.title: 9 COVID-era posts plus a COVID-framed money page
findings.fix: Rewrite disinfection page; 301/merge posts per plan

findings.title: Blog links to a Toronto competitor with a keyword anchor
Blog posts do not link to money pages
findings.evidence: 26/38 posts link to no service, industry or location page; 8 link only to the /services/ hub; top targets are /contact-us/ (27) and /about-us/ (21)
findings.fix: 2-3 contextual links per post to the matching service or industry page

findings.title: Legacy service pages thin, inconsistent or erroneous
findings.evidence: 167-310 unique words; typos 'psychically'; 22-place service area contradicts 10-city schema; industrial page lists retail, banks, golf clubs
findings.fix: Rebuild on the office-cleaning template with FAQs, scope, price factors

findings.title: Industry and service coverage gap vs Jan-Pro
findings.evidence: 2 industry pages vs 16; missing janitorial, carpet, floor care, day porter, window, dental, retail, education, industrial, government, banks

findings.title: Price factors but no ranges
findings.fix: Publish a Toronto pricing guide with honest ranges

findings.title: Blog has zero list markup; 10 posts have no H2; all under 1,500 words
findings.fix: Convert checklists to lists and tables; fix heading hierarchy

findings.title: Unsupported 'certified' and 'health-grade' claims; WSIB/insurance asserted without evidence

strengths: Rebuilt core pages (office, commercial, building maintenance, post-construction, 2 industries, our-process) have intent-matched H1s, scope and limits, price-factor lists and 3-7 FAQs with FAQPage schema; they beat Jan-Pro on FAQs, readability and transparency
Consistent, specific trust facts: since 1989, full NAP and hours, WSIB/bonded/insured, single-office honesty on location pages
Readable copy (FK grade about 8-9) and hand-written, non-templated metadata (templated_ratio 0.0)
